# Draft:Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Arabic Language Award

The Mohamed bin Rashid Arabic Language Award is an award launched by Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum to support and promote the Arabic language.
A Global Award
The Mohamed bin Rashid Arabic Language Award is a global prize aimed at spreading the Arabic language and enhancing its status and role worldwide. The number of participating countries in its eighth edition for 2024 reached 65 countries around the world. The distribution of applicants was as follows: 75% from Africa, 23% from Asia, 1% from Europe, and the remainder from the Americas and Oceania. The award also included participants from nine new countries: Mexico, Norway, Poland, Thailand, the Netherlands, the Czech Republic, Djibouti, South Korea, and Mauritius. This highlights the importance and success of the award in reaching a wider audience globally.
Categories
The award's cash prize is 70,000 USD for each category and consists of five categories:
# Education: It includes three sub-categories: Best Initiative for Teaching and Learning Arabic in Early Education, Best Initiative for Teaching Arabic in Schools (Grades 1-12), and Best Initiative for Teaching Arabic to Non-Native Speakers.
# Technology: It includes two sub-categories: Best Initiative for Using Social Media Networks or a Smart Application to Learn and Promote Arabic, and Best Initiative for Developing and Publishing Digital Arabic Content.
# Media and Communication: It includes two sub-categories: Best Arabic Language Work in Electronic Media and Social Media, and Best Initiative to Serve the Arabic Language in Media.
# Language Policy, Planning, and Arabization: It includes two sub-categories: Best Initiative in Language Policy and Planning, and Best Arabization or Translation Project.
# Culture, Thought, and Knowledge Society: It includes two sub-categories: Best Artistic, Cultural, or Intellectual Work Serving the Arabic Language, and Best Initiative to Enhance the Reading Culture and Build a Knowledge Society.
Board of Trustees

* Mohammed Al-Mar Chairman of the Board of Trustees of the Mohamed bin Rashid Arabic Language Award
* Bilal Al-Badur Secretary-General of the Mohamed bin Rashid Arabic Language Award
* Abd Al-Qadir Al-Fassi Al-Fahri President of the Linguistics Association of Morocco
* Mamoun Abdulhalim Wajih Member of the Arab Language Academies of Cairo and Sharjah and Scientific Director of Historical Dictionary of the Arabic Language
* Henada Taha Professor of Arabic Language Chair - Zayed University Member
* Ali Bin Mousa Secretary-General of the International Arabic Language Academy Member
* Obeid Al-Mahiri Chairman of the Academic Committee and Member of the Board of Trustees of Sharjah University Member
